parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the resource.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. You can specify at most 20 IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

*   **VPC**: a VPC
*   **VSWITCH**: a vSwitch
*   **ROUTETABLE**: a route table
*   **EIP**: an EIP
*   **VpnGateway**: a VPN gateway
*   **NATGATEWAY**: a NAT gateway
*   **COMMONBANDWIDTHPACKAGE**: an EIP bandwidth plan

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc tag-resources --resource-type VPC --resource-id vpc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpc TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'vpc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000' --Tag.1.Key FinanceDept --Tag.1.Value FinanceJoshua --ResourceType VPC --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
